2292-2586-3197.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat

147-728-1465.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-728-1465.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-5256-6794.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1115-2034-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

862-1778-4668-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1778-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1263-4871-6798-6887.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2590-4785-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

1494-5014-6822-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Putrid Imp by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-5231-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-5231-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3080-4608-7638.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-7638.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

3605-4812-5686-6553.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5686-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5686-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3234-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2034-3234-3293-5412.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
2034-3234-3293-5412.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1863-2104-4423-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
1863-2104-4423-6886.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

1086-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1086-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

647-1305-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Repeat.

2018-2099-2111.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a blue creature.
2018-2099-2111.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Wingrattle Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Wingrattle Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

65-4033-4050-5220-6280.description:
Activate Basking Rootwalla's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it, discarding it into exile due to its madness ability.
Basking Rootwalla's madness ability triggers, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Basking Rootwalla, adding {U}.
When Basking Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 1, causing you to draw Basking Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

3129-4094-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
3129-4094-5658-6245.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
3129-4094-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

1429-4875-5231-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4875-5231-5402.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {R}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

3705-4050-4772-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1954-4050-5851.description:
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Change of Heart, returning it to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

2645-5343.easyPrerequisites: Bigger on the Inside attached to Staff of Domination.
2645-5343.description:
Activate Staff of Domination by tapping it, adding two mana of any color and causing the next spell you cast this turn to have cascade.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1932-4179-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
1932-4179-5064.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each creature opponents control and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

2440-2850-3192.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2440-2850-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Ivy Lane Denizen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ulasht.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Saproling you control.
Repeat.

2415-3297-4508.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
2415-3297-4508.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Pirate" on Malcolm to "Devil" until end of turn.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-2158-2577.notablePrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-2577.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1369-2614-3172.notablePrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-2614-3172.description:
Cast Sylvan Paradise by paying {G}, causing Quicksliver Elemental to become green until end of turn.
Activate all Forests and green mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain all abilities from Patron of the Orochi until end of turn.
Activate Quicksliver Elemental using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1336-2635-3716.notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite does not have summoning sickness.
1336-2635-3716.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{R}{R}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite and giving it +7/+7 until end of turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing at least two damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

108-4013-4893.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer's ability by paying {C}, blinking Eyeless Watcher.
Eyeless Watcher enters the battlefield tapped, triggering itself, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may activate any number of them.

2713-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
